[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T13:31:59Z, by staff] Analog Devices Issues Statement Regarding Tutanota Mini-Tender Offer
Analog Devices, Inc. has requested that its shareholders be provided with a copy of its official response regarding a mini-tender offer initiated by Tutanota for shares of ADI common stock.
Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) has issued a formal communication regarding a mini-tender offer for its common stock initiated by Tutanota. The company has requested that this response be included with all materials distributed to shareholders concerning the offer. This action is a standard governance procedure to ensure shareholders are informed of the company's position on the unsolicited tender offer.
[Other material headlines on this company in the window]
- 2026-10-21T13:08:11Z Analog Devices Recommends That Shareholders Reject Tutanota's Unsolicited Mini Tender Offer To Purchase Up To 100K Shares At $525/Share In Cash

memos_so_far.headline: Routine: Analog Devices tells holders to reject a mini-tender for 100,000 shares
reasoning: Primary source: ADI's release on PR Newswire, 'Analog Devices Recommends Shareholders Reject Mini-Tender Offer by Tutanota LLC' (Benzinga 13:08 UTC: 'Unsolicited Mini Tender Offer To Purchase Up To 100K Shares At $525/Share In Cash').

A mini-tender is an offer for under 5% of a company's shares that skips most tender-offer rules. 100,000 shares is about 0.02% of ADI. Companies routinely tell holders to reject them; these offers usually carry conditions and long delays that make the headline price hard to collect.
What changed for the business: nothing. 'Tender offer' in the headline scored it 3.
Price: ADI +1.9% on the day, with the market.
objections: A mini-tender for 0.02% of the shares; no bearing on the company.
